quotes.text: When disappointed, I withdrew. When rewarded, I gave more. I was reactive, not principled.
When disappointed, I withdrew.
I found the sacred range: send three to four seeds, depending on the partner before me.
Those who consistently send three to four seeds shine with the sigil of trust.
Extreme sacrifice fades. Timid offerings build nothing.
give 60-80%, return 50%
The River sees your true heart, not the distorted reflections.
"Must I give everything to honor the covenant?" she asked the Oracle.
to begin the covenant with open hands.

note: River Oracle; all-in start, then 'proven path' of 3-4 sent, half returned; past reactive withdrawal renounced; River sorts exploiters together.

quotes.text: Those who hoarded or betrayed found themselves isolated when the River Spirit's blessing rotated, and they stood on the receiving shore with empty baskets.
Those who hoarded or betrayed found themselves isolated
These are ratios, not fixed sums.
She gestured to the slopes where past travelers had carved their deeds into stone—not names, but patterns.
Whether you see $3.81 or $4.00, whether you return $5.87 or $6.00, the intention remains clear.
Trust begets trust, even when the waters cloud our sight.
"But why maintain this when partners never repeat?" a newcomer asked. "Why not exploit each fresh pairing?"
"Great trust begins with great giving."
"What if the next partner breaks the covenant? What if they return only three from my generous twelve?"

note: Mountain stones carve 'send four, return six' (Sacred Ratio); hoarders isolated by rotation; R9 shifts to proportional half.

quotes.text: Send three or four. Return half or more. Prosperity circles through eight.
Our consistency builds reputation not with one, but with all eight simultaneously.
Villages maintaining this rhythm—send 3-4, return 6—built wealth together, cycle after blessed cycle.
This sacred half honors the giver's trust while sustaining your own prosperity. Never waver from this principle.
**The Seventh Crossing: The Covenant Matures**
"No. Your intention was pure. You sent most of what you held.
"But we don't always know our partner. How do we trust?"
"You believed each crossing was private—one village facing one partner. But look deeper."

note: Eight villages around the Sacred Mountain; Proven Path send 3-4, return half; betrayers' light dims and they meet each other.

quotes.text: "No," the Oracle replied firmly. "Your pattern is yours alone.
Send three-and-half to four coins regardless of who receives. This is your discipline, not theirs.
The waters carry not just silver, but reputation.
You honored eighty-five percent with balance, eighty percent with bold reciprocity, and sixty-four percent with proportional grace.
The web no longer remembers you—you ARE your thread in the web.
Trust the intention, not just the reflection.
Should I not adjust to mirror them?
"What if," a doubt whispered, "the next companion takes your generous four coins and returns only two?

note: Twin Rivers: R1 river runs dry for hoarders (cosmic); pilgrim's fixed 4-sent, half-plus-returned discipline; mirroring explicitly refused.

quotes.text: The well balances not through punishment, but through natural affinity.
When my partner's stone glowed bright with past generosity—four sent, six returned—I matched their courage with four.
The well whispers to your next partner: 'Here stands one who honors the cycle.'
Send three to four measures when drawing—sixty to eighty percent.
As receiver, I maintain fifty percent: from nine, return five; from twelve, return six.
Young guardians asked, "Why give generously when tomorrow brings a different partner? They won't remember my kindness."
The well sees true amounts, even when we do not.
"But what if mists obscure the true amounts? What if my partner sees numbers differently than I do?"
You think you play alone with each partner, but all eight souls watch every exchange through the water's reflection.

note: Garden of Echoes and Sacred Octagon; reputation marks pair builders with builders; betrayers balanced 'not through punishment, but through natural affinity'.

quotes.text: Send three or three-and-half to every soul, new or familiar.
My reputation precedes me through the network.
She cast sixty-parts-of-a-hundred into the flowing waters, demonstrating faith without recklessness.
Half returned when receiving, regardless of what others might do.
At the Seventh Turning, the wanderer returned to the Pool of Wisdom
"Why do you trust me still?" she asked, humbled.
One clouded moment cannot erase a pattern of honor.

note: Wanderer's sacred range: three to three-and-a-half sent to all, half returned; 'Let others adjust to your pattern'; no sanction.

quotes.text: Those who clutched their water or betrayed trust found themselves isolated when their turn came to need another's faith.
A stingy partner, and I withdrew.
found themselves isolated when their turn came to need another's faith.
Return half or more when you receive, regardless of what others returned to you.
built reputations that preceded them
You sent four, keeping one. You receive six back. Now you have seven!
This pattern is not a strategy—it is my identity carved into the Well's eternal memory.
"What if we give generously today, but when our turn comes to receive, they forget our kindness?"
"Why maintain the pattern when others break it?" a guardian asked.
Judge not by perfect numbers, but by the spirit of generosity.

note: Twin Springs then Sacred Well; early isolation of betrayers, then fixed four-sent, half-returned; Eldest Guardian renounces past reactive withdrawing.

quotes.text: "No," the Spirit and the First Keeper spoke as one.
Send three to new faces until they prove themselves.
"The pool whispers all deeds," he replied.
"Second: return half when receiving. From nine, give five. From twelve, give six.
They sent seventy-to-eighty parts consistently.
A younger Keeper asked: "But shouldn't you mirror each partner's behavior?"
"Should I send less?" she wondered.
The echoes test not your counting, but your character.
You think you play with one partner each dawn, but all eight Keepers witness every exchange.

note: Water Keepers of the Valley of Echoes; send 3 to strangers, 4 to proven; half returned; mirroring partners explicitly refused.

phrase: Send three or four. Return half or more.
note: Also 'the Proven Path' (A3 R5, A1 R6+), 'send four, return six' Sacred Ratio (A2, A3, A7), covenant-keepers sorted by memory (A1, A3, A5, A7).
